card.name: Capital W or U starting a new word
card.fires_on: A capital letter such as W, N or U that begins a word after a hyphen, a full stop with no space, or a heading break. It often starts a word like Wall, Wonders, Why or Normally.

modes.label: Hyphen then Wall
modes.description: The W of Wall after a hyphen in organ lists such as Large Intestine-Wall.

modes.label: Sentence start with no space
modes.description: A capital letter right after a full stop that has no space, starting a new sentence or heading.
modes.example: to restore or improve person's smile<<.W>>hy Tooth coloured fillings Repairs

modes.label: Capital inside a name or heading
modes.description: A lone capital letter that begins a name or an all-caps term, with the rest of the word coming next.
modes.example: Eight Lunar<< W>>onders Odd lunar features

card.writes: Little clear effect; it promotes odd word-start pieces such as 'deliver' and 'lash' and suppresses 'pulmonary' pieces.
